In-game tests for Ryan · 8 open checks

Each cell already holds the best-evidence value. These quick tests settle the rest. Done: Rallying Call buffs you solo (Bars, Oct 22 2026).

  1. Barsboldia · Family Chorus solo stamina: Book: ~+10% (calc). Stand still on 4 legs from empty to full stamina and time it with and without Family Chorus: base ~150 s, with +10% ≈ 137 s.
  2. Barsboldia · regen pause after spending stamina: Book assumes recovery starts at once. Use Sweep, then watch the bar: note whether it refills immediately or after a delay (and how long).
  3. Amargasaurus · Disorienting Bellow cooldown: Book: 120 s (NexLink); Potservers and wiki say 60 s. Use it and time until the icon is ready again.
  4. Pycnonemosaurus · Deep Breaths stamina cost: Book: 0 (NexLink); Potservers says 5. Use it at half stamina while standing still and watch whether the bar drops by 5.
  5. Deinocheirus · Claw Attack cooldown: Book: 1.5 s; NexLink older family says 2 s. Spam it on a tree or critter for 30 s and count hits: ~20 at 1.5 s, ~15 at 2 s.
  6. Eurhinosaurus · Bloodthirsty re-trigger: Book: 30 s (NexLink); tooltip says 90 s. Land bleed hits and watch when the heal buff can re-trigger after it starts.
  7. Tylosaurus · Hard Skull stamina recovery: Book: +20% (Oct 13 hotfix); NexLink and wiki 15%. Time a standing refill from empty: base ~111 s, +20% ≈ 93 s, +15% ≈ 97 s.
  8. Tyrannotitan · Dash cost: Book: ~4.5 per full 3 s dash (calc: 0 upfront + 1.5/s); Potservers says 8. Compare stamina lost over a 3 s sprint with and without Dash: the extra should be ~4.5.

Reading the book

★ Recommendations: highlighted entries are the best creature to win with in each class: apex carnivore, apex herbivore, 4-slot herbivore and carnivore, 3-slot, 2-slot, aquatic and flyer. Picks are based on watching post-TLC official-server fight footage (who won, against whom, and in what conditions), then current stats. Speed and stamina are weighed as a real secondary factor. Each creature’s ‘Footage watched’ section lists the clips used. Every creature still has a full win-focused solo kit; ★ stars always equal the slot’s equip count.

Base stats: adult G5 defaults from current NexLink pages. Equipped perks, wetness, stacks, position, and opponent weight change a real fight.

Attacks: ★ means equipped in the displayed build. Every attack is still listed. Damage per cooldown is a rough raw ratio, not sustained combat DPS; it omits windup, animation, misses, shared cooldowns, armor, and combat-weight scaling.

Multi-hit attacks: full-series ratios assume every listed hit connects. Split piercing damage and weight-scaled attacks are labeled rather than forced into one false DPS ranking.

Cell labels: every cell holds a value. “0 (free)” = no stamina cost in the game data; “0 (passive)” = a triggered or passive effect with no activation cost; “n/a (…)” says why a number does not apply; “~x (calc)” is arithmetic from published values and has a matching in-game test.

Source badges: adult default curves and all 38 ability lists were checked. Ability names, categories, tooltips, and prices use the Potservers export (re-checked October 22, 2026; dataset Oct 20). Exact maximum equip counts agree with the current wiki lists for all 38 creatures (Stego, Alio and Leeds pages are now post-TLC). Only Kentro’s Front Limb capacity (Shoulder Check) is provisional. Land sprint and trot, swim sprint and fly sprint are verified against the game-data export (Oct 22, 2026 check). Swim trot and fly cruise come from the wiki stat tables.

Swaps: choose them before a fight. The rotation uses only the displayed kit. Fixed/generic abilities are separated from optional slots.

Conditional attacks: Stego Tail Swing’s current branch is mapped, but charging changes practical damage output. Ano Smash has area and weight-scaled direct damage, so a fixed total hit is not supplied. Kit picks in v3 draw on about 45 watched post-TLC official-server fight clips; tier-list videos and build threads were only secondary. Numbers come only from game data. In-game: Ryan confirmed Rallying Call buffs you solo (Oct 22 2026); open checks are under ‘In-game tests for Ryan’.

  • Movement: swim sprint added for 28 land creatures and flyers (Potservers swim speed = wiki); swim trot from the wiki stat tables; fall death speed for all 38 (NexLink, cm/s; Pachy 3,350 hotfix); fly speeds “n/a (cannot fly)” for non-flyers.
  • Stamina: 47 blank costs → “0 (free)” (no cost curve anywhere). Ceratosaurus Bite fixed: the “10” was the crush variant’s cost; the normal bite is free. Status column filled for 143 attacks.
  • New attack rows: Albertaceratops Counterattack (60 / 7 s / 3), Rhamphorhynchus Scab Picker (1 / 2 s / free).
  • Hunted gaps (all 0 stamina, passive): Ano Rushed Stride, Conc Bloodthirsty, Eurhino Bloodthirsty, Hatz Corpse Stealer, Leeds Rough Scales, Struthi Leap, Tylo Hard Skull (AoE ≤27; recovery +20%). Tail Fan (Deino, Laten): n/a (speed boost, no damage).

v3.2 — Balance Changes (Oct 13 2026)

  • Source: Official PoT Discord #announcements ‘Balance Changes’ (‘will take a few hours to roll out to all servers’), via screenshots posted to Reddit r/pathoftitans (1x53otu, Tue Oct 13 2026 1:54 PM ET). Both pages applied.
  • Stegosaurus: Strong Stance stamina recovery boost 15% → 5%; Clamp damage vs unclampable targets 100 → 80; Clamp stamina 4 → 3; Tail Attack 50 → 55; Tail Attack clamp damage 20 → 40; Swerve stamina 6 → 3; Tail Barrage bleed −50% (0.4 → 0.2 per hit); sprint stamina cost 1.6 → 1.45/s; Charged Tail (Tail Swing) stamina 8 → 3; Ungulatus bleed +5% → +10%; Stenops attack +3% → +5%. Dev note: more stamina for Stego’s stamina-heavy abilities, slight Clamp improvements, two subspecies buffed to compete with the health subspecies.
  • Tylosaurus: Bite 65 → 60; Hard Skull stamina recovery 15% → 20%; Bone Snap 105 → 90; Bone Snap fracture 30 → 20. Dev note: Tylo was overly strong compared with its aquatic peers, so Bone Snap was brought closer to Crushing Bite and the base bite slightly reduced. Hard Skull now gives more stamina recovery to make hit-and-run Charged Headbutt play more effective.
  • Pachycephalosaurus: fall death speed 3000 → 3350 (newly shown; the book had no prior value); Charge stamina 10 → 20; Charged Headbutt cooldown 10 s → 8 s and stamina 4 → 2; Domed Skull Charge-cost reduction 50% → 25%; Surefooted fall-damage reduction 15% → 5%; Spinifer attack +3% → +5%. Dev note: Charge is harder to spam; some fall resistance moved from abilities to the base kit; Charged Headbutt given more punch in its slot.
  • Struthiomimus: food/water drain ~35 → ~40 min; ground acceleration +25% (base); Hustle stamina 10 → 5; Dust Off cooldown 300 s → 180 s; Herbivore Parade range 75 → 100 m; Altus acceleration +50% → +25% (no net change after the base buff). Food drain and base acceleration aren’t book fields, so they’re listed here only.
  • Picks unchanged: Tylosaurus stays the Aquatic pick and Stego keeps its Oct 8 build. Pachy’s equipped kit (Kick + Kickboxer, Batter, Surefooted, Long Distance Runner) is kept; Charge as a swap is now costlier. All flagged for re-check once the change is live.
